description: GPU load balancer 7-term scoring weights and priority bin thresholds. Loaded from gpu_load_balancer.json if not inlined.

weight_residency.description: Weight for expert residency overlap term

weight_capacity.description: Weight for compute capacity term (queue depth / compute_weight)

weight_headroom.description: Weight for VRAM headroom term (free fraction)

weight_affinity.description: Weight for soft affinity match term

weight_transfer_cost.description: Weight for transfer cost term (bin-aware, urgency-modulated)

weight_cache_quality_stable.description: Weight for stable-zone cache quality (mean eviction score of stable residents)

weight_cache_quality_streaming.description: Weight for streaming-zone cache quality (mean eviction score of streaming residents)

priority_bin_thresholds.description: Sorted ascending priority thresholds defining N+1 bins. Must match TransferEngine::Options::priority_bin_thresholds.

learned_scorer_enabled.description: Enable online-trained MLP latency predictor as alternative to heuristic scorer. Falls back to heuristic when cold.

learned_scorer_hidden_size.description: Hidden layer size for learned GPU scorer MLP

learned_scorer_learning_rate.description: Adam learning rate for learned GPU scorer

learned_scorer_buffer_size.description: Ring buffer capacity for training samples

learned_scorer_min_samples.description: Minimum samples before MLP predictions are used (cold-start guard)
